freeze: before dataset generation, training, or results
purpose: real synthesis, summary-template removal and trained graph-contribution comparison; method port not original PPA reproduction

data.dedup: truth-table fingerprint before split acceptance; exclude conflicting duplicate samples, preserve family partitions
data.summary: coarse behavioral properties only; no AST/operation/constant/ID/netlist statistics; explicitly heuristic, no LLM
data.graph_encoding: word-level operand pins and output bits explicitly preserve bit position; gate cells are single-bit

synthesis.tool: YoWASP-packaged Yosys/ABC, open distribution; version recorded at execution
synthesis.rtl: proc then DFF D/Q boundary extraction

learning.equal_budget: same 400 minibatches and model dimensions; all variants retain same allocated parameter modules, inactive graph-specific losses omitted; report trainable gradient parameter counts; text-only uses same code-summary fusion but no graph objectives

controls.shuffled_pairing: seeded random derangement within training family, fixed per seed; never test pairs
controls.shuffled_edges: deterministic edge rewiring within RTL graph, preserves node features/count; excludes netlist perturbation
controls.no_graph: remove graph memory and graph objectives during training/evaluation
controls.text_only: code+summary pooled concatenation projected through a separate same-width head; no graph or cross-attention; new baseline

primary: paired minus no_graph and text_only R1
metrics.uncertainty: per-seed and paired parent bootstrap 2000 draws; do not pool cones as independent parents

downstream.predictor: ridge alpha=1 on standardized embedding plus available RTL operator-count features, compare same plus top3 retrieved structural metrics

integrity: explicit sample IDs and source hashes
no IDs/paths/variable instance names in features
independent gate JSON evaluator agrees with reference and extracted operator graph
Yosys formal equality of RTL cone and mapped gate netlist
tampered output gate must fail semantic check
